items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: The only time I seen George Bakke was about a couple of years before he died. ... I seen him working up, rap off the street and the bar up.

ctx.x: Do you remember George Bakke? Did you hear him? He left here pretty early, I think, with Kepard and those fellows. Do you remember hearing him, though, when you were a boy? No, I don't.

The only time I seen George Bakke or knew anything of George Bakke, of course, I had heard of him. The only time I seen George Bakke was about a couple of years before he died. When he came back? Yeah, after he came back here, I seen him working up, rap off the street and the bar up.
Another player is Charlie McCurtis. Do you remember him? Charlie McCurtis?
